description: Land Acquisition - Thalawathugoda, Maharagama D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. It details the government's intention to acquire specific plots of land for a public purpose, including descriptions of the land lots, their locations, claimants, and extents. The content is exclusively focused on land and property matters, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
